summary: iter413cs Deployment Watch Window + AI Operations Cards 2/6 + Release Timeline — full backend and frontend verification PASSED. All 8 backend pytests green; all required frontend testids render and the annotation modal + timeline search work end-to-end with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy_watch._open_watch lazy-closes prior active watches with summary={'health':'unknown'} — preserves history but loses real metrics for the auto-closed one. Acceptable: intent is to keep only one active watch at a time.
Boot hook uses 'local-<YYYY-MM-DD>' as build_id when BUILD_SHA is unset; means dev/preview opens a fresh watch every day. Intentional per agent_to_agent_context_note.
release-timeline endpoint pulls up to 5000 ai_diagnosed_bug rows in one query — fine at current scale; revisit if >10k bugs land in a quarter.
test_credentials: Admin: maker_auth.issue_admin_magic_token(ADMIN_EMAILS[0]) → /admin/verify?token=… (15-min single-use). ADMIN_EMAILS first entry = williams342@gmail.com in this preview env.
seed_data_creation: test_emerging_clusters_finds_new_post_watch seeds 3 ai_diagnosed_bug rows then wipes them on cleanup. test_iter413cs lifecycle tests create + close watches whose build_ids start with 'iter413cs-test-', 'annotate-', 'search-', 'emerging-', 'sweep-' — they remain in deploy_watches but as closed history rows (intentional — they exercise the history path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Boot hook runs on every backend supervisor restart — that creates a new active watch keyed on `local-<YYYY-MM-DD>`. To force a different active watch in a test, POST /api/admin/ops/deploy-watch/start with a custom build_id. Frontend testid set is exhaustive: deployment-watch-panel, deploy-watch-banner, deploy-watch-build, deploy-watch-health, deploy-health-card, release-timeline, release-timeline-search, release-row-<build_id>, release-annotate-<build_id>, release-annotate-modal, release-annotate-features, release-annotate-notes, release-annotate-save. Admin auth = /admin/verify?token=<magic_token from issue_admin_magic_token>; setting cm_admin_jwt in localStorage alone is NOT sufficient — AdminDashboard validates via /api/admin/me on mount.
